import.title: Import a CSV
import.default_cellar: Default cellar (used when a row has no cellar/location match)
import.help: Choose any CSV file. CellarManager will detect its columns, suggest matches, and let you preview the result before anything is imported.
export.title: Export to CSV
stats.title: Statistics
moveplan.title: Move plan
moveplan.intro: Suggested moves to keep each cellar's mix well matched to its purpose. Nothing moves until you apply a step.
moveplan.no_moves: No moves suggested right now - your cellars look well organized.
picks.title: What should I open?
picks.empty_state: No wines match those criteria yet.
auth.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
auth.registration_closed: Registration is closed. Ask an existing user to create your account.
dashboard.no_bottles_hint: Import a CSV or add your first bottle to see your collection statistics.
dashboard.no_cellars: No cellar has been defined yet.
offline.problems_intro: Offline changes are never silently discarded. Review conflicts or failed changes here, then retry or explicitly discard them.
offline.no_problems: There are no unresolved offline changes.
offline.problems: {conflicts} conflict(s), {failed} failed offline change(s) need attention.
offline.problem_unknown: The server rejected this offline change.
offline.discard_confirm: Discard this preserved offline change? This cannot be undone.
login.setup_token_hint: Required only when WINECELLAR_SETUP_TOKEN is configured on the server.
auth.invalid_setup_token: The initial setup token is incorrect.
cellars.layout_empty: Add a rack to draw the cellar.
import.mapping_intro: For each CellarManager field, choose the corresponding CSV column. A fallback column is used only when the primary value is empty.
import.remember_mapping: Remember this mapping for files with the same headers on this browser
import.saved_mapping_loaded: A saved mapping for this header layout was restored.
import.detected: Detected {rows} data row(s), {columns} column(s), separator “{delimiter}”, encoding {encoding}.
import.mapping_duplicate: A CSV column cannot be assigned to more than one CellarManager field.
import.unassigned_report: {bottles} bottle(s) from {rows} row(s) were imported without a cellar.
import.unassigned_next_step: Their locations are preserved. Create cellars with matching location rules and CellarManager will assign them automatically.
import.no_cellars_title: No cellar has been created yet
import.no_cellars_help: You may still import now. Bottles will keep their location and remain clearly marked as unassigned until a matching cellar rule is created.
cellars.location_rule_help: For unusual legacy codes only. This field accepts a plain prefix or a regular expression; the guided grid is safer for normal use.
cellars.unassigned_summary: {bottles} bottle(s) in {holdings} holding(s) are not assigned to a cellar.
cellars.unassigned_help: Add or edit location rules, then run reconciliation. Matching bottles are moved with a journal entry; unmatched bottles remain visible here.
cellars.no_reconciliation_match: No unassigned bottle matches the current location rules.
cellars.reconciled_after_save: Cellar saved and {bottles} bottle(s) were assigned automatically.
cellars.location_naming_help: Describe the labels printed in your CSV and on your racks. CellarManager generates the matching rule and the labelled grid for you.
cellars.cellar_code_help: The part that identifies this cellar. Example: M in MA1.
cellars.separator_help: Optional character between parts, such as - for M-A-1. Leave empty for MA1.
cellars.code_order_help: Choose the order used by the labels already present in your CSV or cellar.
cellars.store_internal_location: Inside this cellar, display only the position (A1) rather than the full import code (MA1)
cellars.store_internal_location_help: Recommended. The cellar is already shown separately, so its prefix does not need to be repeated on every bottle.
cellars.location_preview_truncated: Only the first {count} positions are shown in this preview.
cellars.scheme_error_column_letter: Column limits must each be one letter from A to Z.
cellars.scheme_error_row_number: Row limits must be whole numbers between 0 and 999.
cellars.scheme_error_prefix_too_long: The cellar code must be 20 characters or fewer.
cellars.scheme_error_separator_too_long: The separator must be at most 3 characters.
cellars.scheme_error_column_range: The first column must come before the last column.
cellars.scheme_error_row_range: The first row must be less than or equal to the last row.
cellars.scheme_error_grid_too_large: This grid is too large. Use at most 1,000 positions.
cellars.scheme_error_generic: The location naming configuration is invalid.
cellars.no_named_grid: No guided grid is configured. Edit the cellar to create one, or continue using the legacy rack editor below.
cellars.grid_explanation: CSV codes run from {first} to {last}. The configured cellar code is {prefix}.
cellars.legacy_layout_help: This is the legacy custom rack editor. Configure Location naming above to use a labelled row/column grid instead.
cellars.location_structure_help: Choose the physical organization. CellarManager generates valid labels, matching rules and the visual layout; regular expressions are not needed.
cellars.named_containers_help: Optional. Enter one name per line, for example Box 1, Box 2 or Shelf. Unlisted names can still be accepted when free text is enabled.
cellars.allow_free_text: Allow other box or container names after the cellar code
cellars.allow_free_text_help: Example: STC Carton rouge is assigned to this cellar and stored as Carton rouge.
cellars.sub_separator_help: For A1.1 use a dot. This separator is distinct from the optional separator between the cellar code, column and row.
cellars.depth_positions_help: Enter one per line as CODE=Label, for example F=Front and B=Back. Codes can also be 1, 2, 3.
cellars.loose_prefix_warning: Without a cellar code, imported unassigned bottles cannot identify this loose cellar automatically. Select it as the default cellar during import.
cellars.location_preview_positions: Preview: {positions} valid positions in a {rows} × {columns} physical layout
cellars.structure_explanation: {type}: {positions} positions. Imported labels run from {first} to {last}.
cellars.scheme_error_prefix_invalid: The cellar code cannot contain a line break.
cellars.scheme_error_containers_too_many: Use at most 200 named boxes or containers.
cellars.scheme_error_sub_range: The first sub-position must be less than or equal to the last.
cellars.scheme_error_sub_separator_requi: A separator is required before a numeric sub-position.
cellars.scheme_error_sequential_label: The first sequential label must contain letters A to Z and the generated labels must not go beyond ZZZ.
cellars.scheme_error_depth_code: Each depth code must contain 1 to 8 characters without spaces.
cellars.scheme_error_depth_duplicate: Each depth code must be unique.
cellars.scheme_error_depth_required: Enter at least one depth position.
cellars.mode_help_loose: Use this for an unordered cellar or boxes without fixed slots. Only box/container settings are shown.
cellars.mode_help_grid: Define a row-and-column grid such as A1. The drawing orientation does not change the imported location codes.
cellars.mode_help_grid_sub: Define a row-and-column grid with several sub-positions inside each slot, such as A1.1 and A1.2.
cellars.mode_help_sequential: Define a physical grid whose slots are named sequentially A, B, C… in the selected filling direction.
cellars.mode_help_depth: Define numbered rows with depth positions such as Front/Back. Choose whether row 1 is drawn at the top or bottom.
cellars.mode_help_none: No automatic location matching or generated visual layout will be used for this cellar.
cellars.mode_help_advanced: For legacy or unusual codes only. Enter a custom prefix or regular expression.
cellars.first_column_position: First column position in the drawing
cellars.first_row_position: First row position in the drawing
cellars.grid_orientation_help: This changes only the physical drawing. It does not rename A1, B1, A2… or affect CSV matching.
cellars.depth_orientation_help: Choose where the first numbered row appears physically. For cellar rows numbered upward from the floor, select Row 1 at the bottom.
